name: enginesyncconsole
description: Deterministic browser simulation console for a TF33-class eight-engine aircraft.

scripts.test:report: rm -f reports/tests/junit.xml reports/tests/results.json; vitest run --reporter=default --reporter=junit --reporter=json --outputFile.junit=reports/tests/junit.xml --outputFile.json=reports/tests/results.json; status=$?; node scripts/write-test-report.js && exit $status
